shared_elements: human figure rendered in relief on a flat panel
rectangular framed field containing the figure
justification: Both surfaces present human figures carved in low relief within rectangular panel fields, which is about as generic a correspondence as relief sculpture allows. A shows a single large bearded head in strict profile with elaborate headgear, earring and patterned curls filling the whole slab, while B shows small, largely featureless standing full-body figures set in narrow vertical recesses flanking an empty central panel, with no comparable attributes, posture or detailing.
